prompt.project_info: A tranquil morning interior portrait with a quiet window silhouette and unpolished domestic detail.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark hair and understated natural features, seated beside a bed with wrinkled white sheets. She wears a loose white silk long-sleeve sleep shirt and looks toward the window in profile.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical waist-up portrait from the bedside, subject positioned left of a bright window, bed linen filling the lower foreground, warm plain walls, and no text, logos, or branded objects.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft morning backlight from the window at approximately 4800K outlines the hair and covered shoulder silhouette. Keep natural pores, quiet shadow detail, real sheet creases, and gentle film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R V with a 35mm f/1.4 lens, vertical 3:4 crop, realistic sharpness with soft window highlight roll-off, lifted blacks, subtle chromatic aberration, and natural film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic morning portrait of an adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark hair, seated beside a bed with wrinkled white sheets in a softly lit room. She wears a loose white silk long-sleeve sleep shirt and looks out the window in profile. Soft morning light outlines her hair and covered silhouette with a gentle backlit glow, natural unretouched skin texture, tranquil private atmosphere, warm walls, vertical framing, realistic film grain, no text or branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, lingerie, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands
